method: Pool accepted samples of saved_route[:,1]*saved_data_attention + saved_route[:,2]*saved_relation_attention; exclude target; normalize each row to 100%.
ensemble_semantics: Saved routing probabilities and branch attention arrays are ensemble-member means. Source weights use their products, summed over the two branches.
active_figures: Supplementary Fig. S7: JARVIS source weights
annotations: Every defined non-target cell is labelled to one decimal place, including 0.0. Target-self cells are dashes. Each other cell in a zero-acceptance row is N/A. Rounded rows may differ from 100%. Exact values are in CSV.
